about_the_game:
Jungle Shadow is an action-adventure game where you play as a sneaky, but fast warrior that can be ruthless. She is self-trained living and breathing with her sharp blade, mystical red-violet hair and clothes in the gigantic Jungle of Platoshira. Prepare for a long adventure of  threatening animals ahead, difficult lengths of survival, carefully swinging on vines and stealthy moments like being behind the tall plants to avoid getting caught, which being caught will lead to massive amounts of danger. You are in the world's most dangerous Jungle as scientists try to uncover what the Jungle is exactly, how long it existed and what it holds within.

Slashly and Punchy Combat: Swift through and use some parts of the environment to your advantage to slay your enemy with your sharp blade to boost damage. Failing won't be a viable option to your journey in Platoshira. Additionally, you will sometimes automatically activate finishers on enemies, but more might come back for revenge when returning to that location with slightly more health. 

Knife Throwing: Unlock this skill as you gain XP and level up. Throw those knives from a distance from the enemy and pain will be inflicted to take out enemies faster.

Smooth and Swifty Movement: Mastering speed and jump power can work by sprinting in the game and you will be able to avoid deadly attack from frogs or other enemies.

Vine Movement: In some cases, you'll have to use the vines to progress through the land of Platoshira with water or traps underneath, so avoiding that is survival otherwise it is instant defeat to yourself and your adventure ahead.

XP & Levelling Up: Gain strength in the land of Platoshira by cutting up certain plants that drop glowing orbs with different colours equating to different amounts of XP. You can also later on unlock a few areas in different levels. Bash through these rocks with higher levels to unlock that specific area of the Jungle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 or AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750, 1GB or AMD Radeon RX 460
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050, 1GB or AMD RTX 570
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Jungle Shadow is an action-adventure set in the world's most dangerous Jungle — Platoshira. Explore the danger and mysteries ahead using your skills and strength. Meanwhile, scientists slowly uncover the Jungle with rich, advanced technology and AI. Fulfil your objectives ahead.
